periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, slanting downwards towards the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Distinctly oval with vertical elongation, appearing roughly twice as long as it is wide.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate tapering at the lower margin, resulting in a slight teardrop profile where the mass is concentrated in the upper-outer quadrant.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shape with a relatively flat and smooth posterior boundary.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick, encompassing approximately 35% of the visible dorsal torso area between the neck and mid-back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, approximately 1.5 to 2 times the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The ear on the viewer's right is highly rounded, while the ear on the viewer's left appears slightly flattened or compressed against the head due to posture.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced cream-colored or yellowish staining is visible on the fur around the ventral neck and lower muzzle regions, contrasting with the pure white of the cranial fur.
